definition.simple: How much money one tick of price movement is worth for one contract.
definition.balanced: Tick value = [[tick-size]] × [[multiplier]] (or × [[contract-size]]). Profit or loss = ticks moved × tick value × contracts. Never assume two contracts share a tick value.

example: Fictional: tick size 0.25 × multiplier 10 USD = 2.50 USD per tick, per contract.
